# Status Rollup

PROVIDES a deterministic rollup of child node test results
SO THAT the spec-tree status surface and CI
CAN report a parent node's state from its descendants

## Assertions

### Scenarios

- Given a tree with one failing child, when status is computed, then the parent reports failing ([test])

# Status Rollup

PROVIDES a deterministic rollup of child node test results
SO THAT the spec-tree status surface and CI
CAN report a parent node's state from its descendants

## Assertions

### Properties

- Status rollup is deterministic: the same tree always produces the same status ([test](tests/test_status.property.l1.py))

### Compliance

- ALWAYS: a parent with any failing child reports failing ([audit])
